name: repowise
description: Fleet RepoWise workspace MCP pinned at C:/Repos. Enable only when code-intelligence tools are needed; disable when done.

interface.shortDescription: Federated code intelligence for every git repo under C:/Repos.
interface.longDescription: Starts one stdio MCP (`repowise mcp C:/Repos`) when the plugin is enabled. Never persist this server in host MCP config — a persisted stdio entry starts at session start and fans out across hosts. Official RepoWise marketplace plugins are forbidden because they register a second MCP at the nearest repo instead of C:/Repos.
